rover.model_method: Old chassis and measured mount positions; four copies of the newer reviewed leg, mirrored according to the old export. Source URDFs unchanged.
rover.scope: Kinematic crawl preview. Reflected newer legs are a visualization assembly, not verified mirrored hardware. No stability/dynamics or inter-leg collision certification.

roverPlan.note: 80% stance; four swings staggered by a quarter cycle. Constant forward chassis speed while walking; fixed chassis XY during transformations. Swing/stance XY speed ratio is 4 relative to chassis. Grounded transforms are simultaneous with a shared body height.

centered.method: Centered contact; straight XY wheel paths; reversible Gecko routes; fitted attachment height; fixed attachment XY.

terrain.method: Kinematic contact constraints; body height/pitch follow terrain subject to joint envelopes. No force or passive-compliance model.

wristEnvelope.note: Conservative positive secondary bend envelope; 5 degree primary and 1 degree secondary samples. Full local screens remain necessary.

mesh_screen.scope: Discrete local leg screening only; chassis/inter-leg interference and continuous clearance unverified.
